visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a blue sweatshirt with a black cat illustration, adjusts her round-rimmed glasses in a home setting with warm indoor lighting. (2) The scene transitions to a clinical environment showing the '大學眼科' logo on a counter, followed by the woman using various white and silver ophthalmic diagnostic machines for eye examinations. (3) She appears in a light blue surgical cap and yellow gown, sitting in a dark recliner chair; a nurse in pink scrubs cleans her eyelid area with cotton swabs. (4) The woman lies on a surgical table under a large white laser eye surgery machine; a masked doctor in a blue uniform operates on her eye while a transparent plastic drape covers her face. (5) A close-up shows a small glass vial containing a tiny, translucent tissue fragment; then, the woman is seen with white medical tape arranged in a star pattern over her eyes, giving a thumbs-up. (6) She walks outside in a purple cap and dark sunglasses on a city street, then rests in bed at home wearing clear protective goggles. (7) The final sequence shows her recovery routine, including applying eye drops and looking at a laptop, concluding with shots of an outdoor street with yellow lanterns and her relaxing on a sofa.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 這是這是我最後一次戴這副眼鏡. [Slogan]: 近視雷射. (2) [Logo]: 大學眼科. (3) [Subtitle]: 我選擇去很多朋友推的. [Logo]: 大學眼科. (4) [Subtitle]: 術前是要做一連串檢查的. (5) [Subtitle]: 近視程度、角膜厚度. (6) [Subtitle]: 和淚液分泌之類的. (7) [Subtitle]: 確定你的眼睛適合. (8) [Subtitle]: 才能夠動手術. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以可以很放心. (10) [Subtitle]: 當天我是找李文富醫師做. [Slogan]: Smile pro 2.0. (11) [Subtitle]: 過程超級無敵快. (12) [Subtitle]: 一上去手術台呢. (13) [Subtitle]: 醫生會撐開你的眼皮. (14) [Subtitle]: 接下來只要從頭到尾. (15) [Subtitle]: 一直盯著傳說中的「綠點點」. (16) [Subtitle]: 讓機器掃描眼球即可. (17) [Variety]: （但會覺得有東西壓住你的眼球）. [Subtitle]: 因為已經有滴麻藥了. (18) [Subtitle]: 不會有任何不舒服的感覺. (19) [Subtitle]: 接下來醫生親自夾出來你的. (20) [Variety]: 切下來的角膜還可以帶回家留念（？）. [Subtitle]: 我知道聽起來很可怕. (21) [Subtitle]: 但真的不會痛. (22) [Subtitle]: 手術就完成了. (23) [Subtitle]: 術後眼睛狀況每個人都不一樣. (24) [Subtitle]: 有些人第一天會完全看不到. (25) [Subtitle]: 但我是一下床馬上就看得到. (26) [Subtitle]: 就糊糊的 但是可以自己走路的. (27) [Subtitle]: 接下來回家休息睡個午覺. (28) [Variety]: 怎麼一睡醒天黑成這樣？！（現在幾點我是誰）. [Subtitle]: 到傍晚的時候. (29) [Subtitle]: 奇蹟發生了... (30) [Subtitle]: 我完全看得超清楚. (31) [Subtitle]: 算是復原很快的體質. (32) [Subtitle]: 就此告別長達近30年的. (33) [Subtitle]: 近視人生. (34) [Subtitle]: 剛開始晚上睡覺要戴護具. (35) [Subtitle]: 乖乖滴眼藥水. (36) [Subtitle]: 出門要戴墨鏡. (37) [Subtitle]: 一切都很順利. [Variety]: 開心！ (38) [Subtitle]: 雖然說我很快就看得很清楚. (39) [Subtitle]: 但其實第一週我看任何東西. (40) [Subtitle]: 都還是會有一點「光暈感」. (41) [Subtitle]: 很像CCD相機濾鏡的感覺. [Variety]: 滿好看的？ (42) [Subtitle]: 大家如果有做近視雷射. (43) [Subtitle]: 還是要讓眼睛多休息. (44) [Subtitle]: 少看螢幕喔～.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female narration begins over a bright, rhythmic acoustic guitar track; the speech is rapid and clearly enunciated. (2) A subtle digital beep SFX from a machine occurs as the voice describes eye tests, blending with a very clean ambient noise floor. (3) During the surgery explanation, the vocal pitch remains stable but becomes more descriptive, while a mechanical whirring sound is faintly audible. (4) A shimmering 'sparkle' SFX marks the recovery phase, followed by the sound of a plastic cap clicking on an eye-drop bottle. (5) The guitar-driven BGM swells slightly during a montage of the woman walking outside, with a minor increase in urban ambient noise. (6) The video concludes with a friendly, lower-arousal sign-off as the music and ambient layers fade out into studio silence.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Preparation -> Procedure -> Results -> Reflection
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share a personal journey of undergoing laser eye surgery (Smile Pro 2.0) at '大學眼科', providing a step-by-step account from pre-op exams to post-op recovery to encourage others and endorse the clinic's services.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Frequent display of the clinic logo, naming of the specific surgeon, and naming of the surgery technology (Smile Pro 2.0).

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses a high-density text overlay and rapid editing to maintain engagement. It balances medical information with a relatable personal vlog style.
